validation.mainlandPhone: Enter an 11-digit mainland China phone number.

status.existing: Code sent. Enter it to sign in.
status.new: Code sent. A new account will be created for this phone number.

local.title: Sign in to local Rinspace
local.description: Sign in with your own account on rinspace.com, approve access, then return here.
local.realData: This is not a demo. Once authorized, likes, bookmarks and comments use your real account and update production data.
local.unavailable: Official local-client authorization is not enabled or is temporarily unavailable. No sign-in or business write occurred. Please retry later.

consent.title: Authorize a local Rinspace client
consent.invalid: Invalid authorization request, or this is not rinspace.com. Start again from your local client.
consent.description: Allow the local frontend you run to access the Rinspace outer world using your account.
consent.realTitle: You will be changing real data
consent.realData: Local likes, bookmarks, comments, uploads and publishing update the same production data as the website, not a test account or a virtual database.
consent.scopeDescription: Outer world and local session management. The same permissions, quotas, moderation and account restrictions apply. Gitea and the inner world still open on the official website.
consent.trust: Only authorize code you trust and actively run. A public client ID is not proof of safety; a modified frontend can perform actions your account permits. Revoke the local session in device management.
consent.login: Sign in with your own account
consent.failed: Authorization was not completed. Check your account and network before retrying. No simulated authorization is used.
